automaticWholeTrackRuntimeAdmission.globalDecodeAdmission: automatic animation predecode shares FoveaSystem decode-concurrency and decode-working-set permit pools with static decode
automaticWholeTrackRuntimeAdmission.predecodePeakRule: predecode peak must cover decoded + provider-retained steady state and fit the shared decode-working-set limit
automaticWholeTrackRuntimeAdmission.residentBudgetRule: resident decoded bytes + long-lived provider-retained bytes must fit the shared AnimationFrameMemory resident budget after non-evictable pins/reservations; known provider-retained bytes remain charged even if automatic selection falls back to boundedFrameCache

claimBoundary: physical evidence is internal Fovea AppKit presentation evidence on the retained physical Mac, not a third-party or cross-platform ranking
ScreenCaptureKit observes composited window updates, not raw panel scanout, and can under-sample short source frames
/usr/bin/time -l CPU time, cycles, instructions, context switches and RSS are process-resource proxies, not total-system energy
the retained physical A/B begins after the same predecode-all provider work; it does not measure decoder preparation/startup or automatic-admission overhead

automatic whole-track selection is now implemented fail-closed in Fovea runtime, but the production Package.swift still pins an ImageCraft revision without the current public animation API; the current decoder adapter remains source-overlay qualification rather than an ordinary production URL/APNG/GIF entry

owned ImageCraft cost bounds are conservative model bytes, not process RSS; provider-retained accounting models owned retained payload/palette/checkpoint bytes and does not claim exact allocator/object overhead
no total-energy, thermal, universal GIF/APNG throughput, or global Pareto claim
formalClaimScope: The formal physical claim remains the already-retained AppKit presentation-only compositor A/B on fully resident predecodeAll tracks. Later automatic-admission, lifecycle re-offload, and decoder-adapter work is deterministic/overlay evidence and is not retroactively included in the physical claim.

mechanism.clockContract: CA beginTime uses the Core playback cursor effective presentation anchor (current monotonic host time minus active playback elapsed), not the original wall-clock start unconditionally. Paused/background time is therefore excluded; seek/restart receive a fresh phase-consistent anchor.
mechanism.inheritedImageCompatibility: NSImageView.image remains populated; the compositor child layer supplies changing visual contents without clearing inherited image state
mechanism.lastFrameSentinel: animation values append frame 0 at keyTime 1.0 so the final source frame owns its complete [start,1.0) interval before repeat
mechanism.name: resident predecode-all CAKeyframeAnimation contents offload
mechanism.pixelOwnership: compositor snapshots pin already-resident DecodedImage values in AnimationFrameMemory; pins remain charged until the snapshot is released
mechanism.providerOwnership: Whenever a prepared asset can prove long-lived provider payload/palette/checkpoint byte cost, that cost is reserved by handle identity in the same AnimationFrameMemory resident budget for fixed, bounded, and predecodeAll strategies. Automatic whole-track upgrade additionally requires decoded-resident and predecode-peak proofs. Reservation release occurs only after provider cancellation; critical frame purge does not pretend a still-live provider has been freed.

reoffload.applicationActive: active resume revalidates resident snapshot and effective anchor
reoffload.criticalPressure: critical purges resident frames; after normal pressure the next real playback tick refills under normal admission and the one-shot whole-track handoff re-enters the compositor
reoffload.explicitPause: resume revalidates resident snapshot and effective anchor
reoffload.geometryOrFrameStyle: unsupported geometry/frame style tears down; restoration revalidates and re-offloads. Eligibility is checked again after awaits to close MainActor reentrancy.
reoffload.initiallyHidden: animation start is deferred until first visibility; PT_183 proves the first visible start can enter the compositor without a separate deferred-upgrade state machine
reoffload.restart: restart uses a new effective anchor and re-offloads resident frames
reoffload.seek: seek reanchors and re-offloads resident frames without provider decode
reoffload.visibility: visible resume revalidates resident snapshot and effective anchor
reoffload.warningPressure: warning invalidates compositor; normal pressure revalidates without provider decode when frames remain resident

mechanism.summary: When an eligible whole track is resident, AppKit installs a discrete contents CAKeyframeAnimation on a child layer and pauses its view display link while Core Animation owns source-frame presentation. Eligibility loss tears down the compositor; when eligibility returns, the current product can revalidate and re-offload without re-decoding resident frames.

physicalResourceEvidence.interpretation: On the retained nonintrusive physical-Mac endpoint, app-process CPU was about 4.83x lower and cycles about 3.41x lower for the compositor candidate. These are process-resource proxies, not system energy.

productDecision.nextProductObligation: Publish an immutable ImageCraft revision containing the qualified animation API/runtime, move Fovea to that exact pin, compile the qualified adapter into FoveaSystem, rerun clean-pin integration, then measure end-to-end physical startup plus steady-state presentation rather than reopening local AppKit setter/timer micro-tuning.
productDecision.reason: The presentation mechanism passed the retained physical timing/source-progression and process-resource gates. Runtime automatic admission now requires three explicit cost bounds and accounts long-lived provider state in the shared resident budget. Publication remains blocked only at the production ImageCraft pin/adapter seam, not by the AppKit presentation mechanism itself.
